SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    MIN(sale_date) as min_sale_date,
    MAX(sale_date) as max_sale_date,
    COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label,
    d.calendar_date
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2025-11-02'

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) as total_returns
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = frl.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales_net,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as returns_net,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as net_sales_after_returns
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsl.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id AND frl.return_date <= '2025-12-31'
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(rds.net_sales) as net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = rds.business_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = rds.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    AND s.store_id = 900
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT store_id, store_name, format
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id >= 900
AND is_current = true
